"'''Inevitable Outcome'''" was a highly experimental [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] developed by [[Czerka Arms/Legends|Czerka Arms]] during the [[Third Galactic War]]. Merely obtaining the weapon required signing a waiver.<ref name="Bundle" />
